newsitem.title: FRANCE: French prison requested for guerrilla "Tigress".
newsitem.headline: French prison requested for guerrilla "Tigress".

text.p: A prosecutor asked a French court on Thursday to jail a Spanish Basque guerrilla known as "The Tigress" to police, who say she is among the most ruthless members of the separatist group ETA.
Prosecutor Irene Stoller said Idoia Lopez Riano should be jailed for five years on charges of carrying weapons, belonging to an armed group and using forged identity documents.
The 32-year-old "Tigress", an avowed member of ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) since she was 15, was detained in southern France two years ago.
She is wanted in Spain in connection with 23 murders, including those of 17 paramilitary civil guards, and several car-bomb attacks.
A French court has already ordered her extradition to Spain to follow a possible prison term in France.

Lopez Riano told the Paris court in the Basque language that she regarded herself as a political prisoner. She said she did not recognise the court as legitimate and refused to answer the judges' questions.
ETA has killed 800 people since beginning a drive for Basque independence in 1968.
Lopez Riano smiled broadly to friends in the courtroom and repeatedly made mocking signs toward her French former companion Olivier Lamotte who is also on trial.
He is accused of carrying her pistol when they were arrested together in Aix-en-Provence, southern France.
"I was very much in love with her, and I tried not to care about the rest," Lamotte, 30, told the court.
"Looking at Idoia Lopez, one can understand why," the prosecutor said. "But without people like him, terrorists would be weaker."
She asked the court to jail Lamotte for six months, with another two-and-a-half years suspended on conspiracy charges.
